/// <summary>Сценарии auth (login/change-password): отдельная фикстура — свой счётчик лимита 10/мин.</summary>
public class IntegrationAuthTests : IClassFixture<TecHetAppFactory>
{
    private readonly TecHetAppFactory _f;
    public IntegrationAuthTests(TecHetAppFactory f) => _f = f;

    private (HttpClient, string Token) LoginAdmin()
    {
        var c = _f.CreateClient();
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/login", new { login = "budnikva2@yandex.ru", password = "1661" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);
        var json = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        return (c, json.GetProperty("token").GetString()!);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ChangePassword_FullRotation()
    {
        var (c, _) = LoginAdmin();
        // ротация на выделенном пользователе: сессии и пароль админа не затрагиваются
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/admin/users", new
        { login = "chpw_tester", password = "Passw0rd1", displayName = "Тест ротации", role = "User", licenseDays = 365 }).GetAwaiter().GetResult().StatusCode);
        var c1 = _f.CreateClient();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, c1.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/login",
            new { login = "chpw_tester", password = "Passw0rd1" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult().StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, c1.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/change-password",
            new { oldPassword = "wrong", newPassword = "NewPass1x" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult().StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, c1.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/change-password",
            new { oldPassword = "Passw0rd1", newPassword = "NewPass1x" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult().StatusCode);
        // cookie стёрты сервером: старая сессия не обновляется (refresh отозван)
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Unauthorized, c1.PostAsync("/api/auth/refresh", new StringContent("", System.Text.Encoding.UTF8, "application/json")).GetAwaiter().GetResult().StatusCode);
        // вход с новым паролем и возврат к исходному
        var c2 = _f.CreateClient();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, c2.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/login",
            new { login = "chpw_tester", password = "NewPass1x" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult().StatusCode);
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, c2.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/change-password",
            new { oldPassword = "NewPass1x", newPassword = "Passw0rd1" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult().StatusCode);
        var c3 = _f.CreateClient();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, c3.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/login",
            new { login = "chpw_tester", password = "Passw0rd1" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult().StatusCode);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PhotoUpload_GoesToConfiguredDir()
    {
        var (c, _) = LoginAdmin();
        var plant = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/plants", new { name = "НПЗ-Ф", code = "ZF" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
            .Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        var unit = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/units", new { plantId = plant.GetProperty("id").GetInt32(), name = "АВТ-Ф", code = "UF" })
            .GetAwaiter().GetResult().Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        var asset = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/assets",
            new { unitId = unit.GetProperty("id").GetInt32(), assetType = "аппарат", tag = "К-Ф1", name = "Колонна Ф" })
            .GetAwaiter().GetResult().Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        var defect = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/defects",
            new { assetId = asset.GetProperty("id").GetInt32(), title = "Вмятина ИТ", severity = "средняя" })
            .GetAwaiter().GetResult().Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        int defectId = defect.GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
        // 1×1 PNG
        using var ms = new System.IO.MemoryStream();
        using (var bw = new System.IO.BinaryWriter(ms))
        {
            bw.Write(new byte[] { 0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A });
        }
        // полноценный png не нужен — сервер валидирует только расширение/размер; проверим через Content-Type
        var content = new MultipartFormDataContent();
        var file = new ByteArrayContent(new byte[] { 0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A, 0, 0, 0, 0 });
        file.Headers.ContentType = new System.Net.Http.Headers.MediaTypeHeaderValue("image/png");
        content.Add(file, "file", "photo.png");
        var resp = c.PostAsync($"/api/defects/{defectId}/photo", content).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);
        var json = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        var photoPath = json.GetProperty("photoPath").GetString()!;
        Assert.StartsWith("/uploads/defects/", photoPath);
        var onDisk = Path.Combine(_f.UploadsDir, photoPath.TrimStart('/').Substring("uploads/".Length).Replace('/', System.IO.Path.DirectorySeparatorChar));
        Assert.True(System.IO.File.Exists(onDisk), $"файл не в настроенном каталоге: {onDisk}");
    }
}

=== ФАЙЛ: tests/TecHet.Tests/MixtureTests.cs
using TecHet.Api.DTOs;
using TecHet.Api.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>Правила смешения (Кей и др.) — проверка математических инвариантов.</summary>
public class MixtureMathTests
{
    // Плотность: 1/rho = Σ w_i/rho_i
    [Fact]
    public void Density_HarmonicMixing()
    {
        // компоненты A (M=30, x=0.5) и B (M=58, x=0.5): w_A = 15/44 = 0.3409, w_B = 0.6591
        double mwMix = 0.5 * 30 + 0.5 * 58;
        double wA = 0.5 * 30 / mwMix;
        double rhoA = 600, rhoB = 500;
        double rhoMix = 1.0 / (wA / rhoA + (1 - wA) / rhoB);
        Assert.InRange(rhoMix, 520, 540);   // около 531
    }

    // Вязкость: ln(mu) = Σ xi ln(mu_i) — смесь всегда между компонентами
    [Fact]
    public void Viscosity_LogMixing()
    {
        double muA = 0.001, muB = 0.003;
        double muMix = Math.Exp(0.5 * Math.Log(muA) + 0.5 * Math.Log(muB));
        Assert.True(muMix > muA && muMix < muB);
        Assert.InRange(muMix, 0.0017, 0.0018);   // sqrt(0.001*0.003) ≈ 0.001732
    }

    // Psat (Кей): всегда между Psat компонентов
    [Fact]
    public void Psat_KayRule()
    {
        double pA = 10, pB = 90;
        double pMix = 0.3 * pA + 0.7 * pB;
        Assert.Equal(66.0, pMix, 6);
        Assert.True(pMix > pA && pMix < pB);
    }

    // Cp: массовое смешение
    [Fact]
    public void Cp_MassWeighted()
    {
        double mwMix = 0.7 * 16 + 0.3 * 30;   // метан + этан
        double wMet = 0.7 * 16 / mwMix;
        double cpMix = wMet * 2250 + (1 - wMet) * 1750;
        Assert.InRange(cpMix, 2000, 2100);
    }
}

=== ФАЙЛ: tests/TecHet.Tests/PchipTests.cs
using TecHet.Api.Services;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>PCHIP: монотонность, отсутствие осцилляций и отрицательных значений.</summary>
public class PchipTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void ExactAtKnots()
    {
        var p = new Pchip(new[] { 300.0, 350.0, 400.0, 450.0 }, new[] { 5.0, 4.2, 3.8, 3.2 });
        Assert.Equal(5.0, p.Eval(300.0), 9);
        Assert.Equal(4.2, p.Eval(350.0), 9);
        Assert.Equal(3.2, p.Eval(450.0), 9);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void LinearData_MatchesLinearExactly()
    {
        var p = new Pchip(new[] { 0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 }, new[] { 0.0, 10.0, 20.0, 30.0 });
        Assert.Equal(15.0, p.Eval(1.5), 6);
        Assert.Equal(5.0, p.Eval(0.5), 6);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MonotoneData_StaysMonotone()
    {
        // вязкостной профиль: экспоненциально убывающая кривая
        double[] x = Enumerable.Range(0, 25).Select(i => 300.0 + i * 15.0).ToArray();
        double[] y = x.Select(t => 0.05 * Math.Exp(-0.02 * (t - 300.0)) + 0.0004).ToArray();
        var p = new Pchip(x, y);
        double prev = p.Eval(x[0]);
        for (double t = x[0]; t <= x[^1]; t += 1.0)
        {
            double v = p.Eval(t);
            Assert.True(v <= prev + 1e-12, $"PCHIP не монотонна в t={t}: {v} > {prev}");
            prev = v;
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void PositiveData_NeverNegative_NoOvershoot()
    {
        // резкий излом без осцилляций в обе стороны
        double[] x = { 300, 320, 340, 360, 380, 400 };
        double[] y = { 1.0, 1.01, 1.05, 2.0, 1.9, 1.85 };
        var p = new Pchip(x, y);
        for (double t = 300; t <= 400; t += 0.5)
        {
            double v = p.Eval(t);
            Assert.True(v >= Math.Min(y.Min(), 0.9), $"Overshoot вниз в t={t}: {v}");
            Assert.True(v <= y.Max() * 1.05, $"Overshoot вверх в t={t}: {v}");
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void OutsideRange_ClampsToEdges()
    {
        var p = new Pchip(new[] { 300.0, 400.0 }, new[] { 5.0, 1.0 });
        Assert.Equal(5.0, p.Eval(250.0), 9);
        Assert.Equal(1.0, p.Eval(500.0), 9);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ReversedX_Throws()
    {
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => new Pchip(new[] { 400.0, 300.0 }, new[] { 1.0, 5.0 }));
    }
}

using TecHet.Api.DTOs;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>П-14: контрольные случаи pH; ограничение 5 компонентов.</summary>
public class PhTests
{
    private static double Ph(params PhComponentInput[] comps)
    {
        var r = PhCalc.Run(new PhInput(comps.ToList(), 25.0));
        return (double)r.Result["pH"]!;
    }

    // 0.1 моль/кг HCl (3.646 г/кг): pH ≈ 1.0 (с Дэвисом ≈ 1.08)
    [Fact]
    public void Hcl_01M_PhAbout1()

        Assert.InRange(ph, 0.95, 1.15);
    }

    public void Naoh_001M_PhAbout12()

        double ph = Ph(new PhComponentInput("NaOH", 0.4));
        Assert.InRange(ph, 11.8, 12.2);
    }

    // 0.1 моль/кг CH3COOH (6.005 г/кг): pH ≈ 2.87–2.9
    [Fact]
    public void AceticAcid_01M_PhAbout29()
    {
        double ph = Ph(new PhComponentInput("CH3COOH", 6.005));
        Assert.InRange(ph, 2.7, 3.0);
    }

    }

        Assert.InRange(ph, 6.9, 7.2);
    }

    public void MoreThanFiveComponents_Throws()
    {

using TecHet.Api.DTOs;
using TecHet.Api.Services.Calc;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>П-12: рабочая точка на синтетических характеристиках, NPSH.</summary>
public class PumpTests
{
    // Сеть без потерь: H_сети = H_геом. Насос H = H0 − a·Q² → Q = sqrt((H0−H_геом)/a)
    [Fact]
    public void AnalyticOperatingPoint_NoNetworkLosses()
    {
        double h0 = 40, a = 10, hGeom = 20;
        var i = new PumpInput(null, null, 1000, 0.001,
            0, 0.1, null, 0, 0, 0.1, null, 0, hGeom, null, null, 0, 2.3, 101.325,
            null, h0, a, null, 3.0, 0.7, 1.2);
        var svc = new PumpService(new NoResolver(), new NoProps(), new Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions.NullLogger<PumpService>());
        var r = svc.RunAsync(i).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        double expectedQ = Math.Sqrt((h0 - hGeom) / a);
        Assert.InRange((double)r.Result["operating_point_q_m3s"]!, expectedQ - 1e-4, expectedQ + 1e-4);
        Assert.InRange((double)r.Result["operating_point_H_m"]!, hGeom - 0.01, hGeom + 0.01);
    }

    private class NoResolver : TecHet.Api.Services.IFluidResolver
    {
        public Task<TecHet.Api.Services.ResolvedFluid> ResolveAsync(int? s, double? t, double? rho, double? mu, double? cp, double? kl,
            int? uid = null, bool isAdmin = false)
            => throw new InvalidOperationException("не должен вызываться: свойства заданы вручную");
    }

    private class NoProps : TecHet.Api.Services.IPropertyService
    {

            null, null, null, 3.0, 0.7, 1.2);
        var svc = new PumpService(new NoResolver(), new NoProps(), new Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions.NullLogger<PumpService>());
        var ex = Assert.ThrowsAsync<TecHet.Api.Errors.ValidationException>(() => svc.RunAsync(i)).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Contains("повторяющиеся", ex.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NpshDeficit_Warns()

using TecHet.Api.DTOs;
using TecHet.Api.Errors;
using TecHet.Api.Services.Calc;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

// R15: излучение с наружной поверхности в теплопотерях (surfaceEmissivity)
public class R15Tests
{
    [Fact]
    public void HeatLoss_ConvectiveBaseline_UnchangedWithZeroEmissivity()
    {
        // эталон аудита R7 при ε=0: наружная поверхность −14,1 / −12,1 °C; 76–80 Вт/м
        var cyl = HeatLossCalc.Run(new HeatLossInput(219.0, 100.0, 0.06, 120.0 + 273.15, -20.0 + 273.15, 10.0, 0.0));
        Assert.InRange((double)cyl.Result["outer_surface_T_C"]!, -16.0, -12.0);
        Assert.InRange((double)cyl.Result["heat_loss_W_per_m"]!, 76.0, 80.0);
        var flat = HeatLossCalc.Run(new HeatLossInput(null, 100.0, 0.06, 120.0 + 273.15, -20.0 + 273.15, 10.0, 0.0));
        Assert.InRange((double)flat.Result["outer_surface_T_C"]!, -14.0, -10.0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HeatLoss_Radiation_IncreasesLoss_AndAddsH()
    {
        var baseIn = new HeatLossInput(null, 100.0, 0.06, 120.0 + 273.15, -20.0 + 273.15, 10.0, 0.0);
        var noRad = HeatLossCalc.Run(baseIn);
        var withRad = HeatLossCalc.Run(baseIn with { SurfaceEmissivity = 0.9 });
        double q0 = (double)noRad.Result["heat_loss_W_per_m2"]!;
        double q1 = (double)withRad.Result["heat_loss_W_per_m2"]!;
        double hRad = (double)withRad.Result["h_rad_W_m2K"]!;
        double hTot = (double)withRad.Result["h_total_W_m2K"]!;
        Assert.InRange(hRad, 3.0, 5.0);          // ~3.4 Вт/(м2·К) для этого кейса
        Assert.True(Math.Abs(hTot - (10.0 + hRad)) < 1e-6);
        Assert.True(q1 > q0 * 1.001);            // потери растут
        Assert.True((double)withRad.Result["outer_surface_T_C"]! < (double)noRad.Result["outer_surface_T_C"]!);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HeatLoss_EmissivityDefault_IsNineTenths()
    {
        var cyl = HeatLossCalc.Run(new HeatLossInput(219.0, 100.0, 0.06, 120.0 + 273.15, -20.0 + 273.15, 10.0));
        Assert.Equal(0.9, (double)cyl.Result["surface_emissivity"]!, 2);
        Assert.True((double)cyl.Result["heat_loss_W_per_m"]! > 76.0);   // больше конвективного базиса
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HeatLoss_HotPipe_RadiationIsSignificant()
    {
        // горячий кейс: T процесса 500 °C, тонкая изоляция — излучение даёт заметную долю
        var r = HeatLossCalc.Run(new HeatLossInput(null, 50.0, 0.05, 500.0 + 273.15, -20.0 + 273.15, 10.0, 0.9));
        double hRad = (double)r.Result["h_rad_W_m2K"]!;
        double hTot = (double)r.Result["h_total_W_m2K"]!;
        Assert.True(hRad / hTot > 0.25);
    }

    [Theory]
    [InlineData(-0.1)]
    [InlineData(1.5)]
    public void HeatLoss_InvalidEmissivity_ThrowsValidation(double eps)
    {
        Assert.Throws<ValidationException>(() =>
            HeatLossCalc.Run(new HeatLossInput(null, 100.0, 0.06, 300.0, 273.15, 10.0, eps)));
    }
}

public class R16FileChecks
{
    private static string FindRepoFile(string rel)
    {
        var dir = new DirectoryInfo(Directory.GetCurrentDirectory());
        while (dir != null)
        {
            var p = Path.Combine(dir.FullName, rel);
            if (File.Exists(p)) return p;
            dir = dir.Parent;
        }
        throw new FileNotFoundException(rel);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HeatLossCalc_UsesConsistentResistance()
    {
        var t = File.ReadAllText(FindRepoFile("src/TecHet.Api/Services/Calc/HeatTransferCalc.cs"));
        Assert.Contains("1.0 / (area * hTot)", t);                       // пул 1 п.1: согласованность
        Assert.DoesNotContain("rCond + 1.0 / hTot)", t);                 // старая ошибка отсутствует

    }

        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);

    {
        var c = Admin();
        var j1 = await c.GetFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>("/api/substances?q=water&size=5");
        int waterId = j1.GetProperty("items").EnumerateArray().First().GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
        var j2 = await c.GetFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>("/api/substances?q=dioxide&size=5");
        int co2Id = j2.GetProperty("items").EnumerateArray().First().GetProperty("id").GetInt32();

        var body = new
        {
            components = new object[]
            {
                new { substanceId = co2Id, molFrac = 0.5 },
                new { substanceId = waterId, molFrac = 0.5 },
            },
            t = 310.0,   // CO2 сверхкритичен (Tc≈304), вода нет — раньше был 400 по компоненту
        };
        var resp = await c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/calc/mixture/vle", body);
        Assert.True(resp.IsSuccessStatusCode,
            $"сверхкритичный компонент не должен ломать расчёт: {(int)resp.StatusCode} {await resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync()}");
        var json = await resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>();
        var warns = json.GetProperty("warnings").EnumerateArray().Select(x => x.GetString() ?? "").ToList();
        Assert.Contains(warns, w => w.Contains("сверхкритичны"));
    }
}

using TecHet.Api.Errors;
using TecHet.Api.Services.Calc;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

// R17.2: k_ij-матрица per-pair + PH-слой (энтальпия, PH-flash)
public class R172Tests
{
    private static readonly string[] N3 = { "methane", "ethane", "propane" };
    private static readonly double[] Tc3 = { 190.564, 305.32, 369.83 };
    private static readonly double[] Pc3 = { 4599.2e3, 4872.3e3, 4248.0e3 };
    private static readonly double[] Om3 = { 0.0115, 0.0995, 0.1523 };
    private static readonly double[] Mw3 = { 16.043, 30.07, 44.097 };
    private static readonly double[] Z3 = { 0.4, 0.4, 0.2 };
    private static readonly string[] N2 = { "methane", "ethane" };
    private static readonly double[] Tc2 = { 190.564, 305.32 };
    private static readonly double[] Pc2 = { 4599.2e3, 4872.3e3 };
    private static readonly double[] Om2 = { 0.0115, 0.0995 };
    private static readonly double[] Mw2 = { 16.043, 30.07 };

    private static double Bubble(Dictionary<string, object?> r) => Convert.ToDouble(r["bubble_P_kPa"]!);

    private static Func<double, double>?[] CpConst2() => new Func<double, double>?[] { t => 40.0, t => 60.0 };
    private static Func<double, double>?[] CpConst3() => new Func<double, double>?[] { t => 40.0, t => 60.0, t => 90.0 };

    [Fact]
    public void KijMatrix_ScalarEquivalent()
    {
        // матрица «0.1 на все пары» должна быть численно идентична скаляру kij=0.1
        double pScalar = Bubble(MixtureVleService.Solve(N3, Tc3, Pc3, Om3, Mw3, Z3, 200.0, kij: 0.1));
        var m = new double[3, 3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < 3; j++)
                if (i != j) m[i, j] = 0.1;
        double pMatrix = Bubble(MixtureVleService.Solve(N3, Tc3, Pc3, Om3, Mw3, Z3, 200.0, kij: 0.0, kijMatrix: m));
        Assert.Equal(pScalar, pMatrix, 9);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KijMatrix_PairSpecific()
    {
        // kij только на паре (CH4–C2H6): эффект меньше, чем скаляр на все пары, и больше нуля
        double p0 = Bubble(MixtureVleService.Solve(N3, Tc3, Pc3, Om3, Mw3, Z3, 200.0, kij: 0.0));
        double pAll = Bubble(MixtureVleService.Solve(N3, Tc3, Pc3, Om3, Mw3, Z3, 200.0, kij: 0.1));
        var m = new double[3, 3];
        m[0, 1] = m[1, 0] = 0.1;
        double pPair = Bubble(MixtureVleService.Solve(N3, Tc3, Pc3, Om3, Mw3, Z3, 200.0, kij: 0.0, kijMatrix: m));
        Assert.True(pAll > p0, $"скаляр kij=0.1 должен поднять P_bub: {p0:0.##} → {pAll:0.##}");
        Assert.True(pPair > p0, $"пер-паровая kij (CH4–C2H6) должна поднять P_bub: {p0:0.##} → {pPair:0.##}");
        Assert.True(pPair < pAll, $"эффект одной пары меньше скаляра на все пары: {pPair:0.##} vs {pAll:0.##}");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KijMatrix_RejectsAsymmetric()
    {
        var m = new double[3, 3];
        m[0, 1] = 0.1; m[1, 0] = 0.05;
        var ex = Assert.Throws<ValidationException>(() =>
            MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpyFlash(N3, Tc3, Pc3, Om3, Mw3, Z3, 1000e3, 0.0, 0.0, m, CpConst3()));
        Assert.Contains("симметрич", ex.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void KijMatrix_RejectsNonZeroDiagonal()
    {
        var m = new double[3, 3];
        m[1, 1] = 0.1;
        var ex = Assert.Throws<ValidationException>(() =>
            MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpyFlash(N3, Tc3, Pc3, Om3, Mw3, Z3, 1000e3, 0.0, 0.0, m, CpConst3()));
        Assert.Contains("Диагональ", ex.Message);
    }

    // ---------- PH-слой ----------

    [Fact]
    public void Enthalpy_RoundTrip_TwoPhase()
    {
        // CH4/C2H6 50/50, 200 K, 1000 кПа — двухфазная область (thermo 0.6.1: VL, β=0.5471)
        var cp = CpConst2();
        var (rH, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpy(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 200.0, 1000e3, 0.0, null, cp);
        Assert.Equal("two-phase", Convert.ToString(rH["phase"]));
        double h = Convert.ToDouble(rH["enthalpy_JPerMol"]!);
        var (rF, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpyFlash(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 1000e3, h, 0.0, null, cp);
        double tS = Convert.ToDouble(rF["T_K"]!);
        Assert.InRange(tS, 199.0, 201.0);
        Assert.Equal("two-phase", Convert.ToString(rF["phase"]));
        Assert.InRange(Convert.ToDouble(rF["vapor_fraction"]!), 0.54, 0.555);
        Assert.True(Math.Abs(Convert.ToDouble(rF["h_residual_JPerMol"]!)) < 5.0,
            $"невязка энтальпии после PH-flash должна быть мала: {rF["h_residual_JPerMol"]}");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Enthalpy_SuperheatedVapor()
    {
        // T=280 K > Tdew при P=1000 кПа (thermo: V) — однофазный пар
        var cp = CpConst2();
        var (rH, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpy(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 280.0, 1000e3, 0.0, null, cp);
        Assert.Equal("vapor", Convert.ToString(rH["phase"]));
        double h = Convert.ToDouble(rH["enthalpy_JPerMol"]!);
        var (rF, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpyFlash(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 1000e3, h, 0.0, null, cp);
        double tS = Convert.ToDouble(rF["T_K"]!);
        Assert.InRange(tS, 278.0, 282.0);
        Assert.Equal("vapor", Convert.ToString(rF["phase"]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Enthalpy_SubcooledLiquid()
    {
        // T=150 K < Tbub при P=1000 кПа (thermo: L) — субохлаждённая жидкость
        var cp = CpConst2();
        var (rH, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpy(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 150.0, 1000e3, 0.0, null, cp);
        Assert.Equal("liquid", Convert.ToString(rH["phase"]));
        double h = Convert.ToDouble(rH["enthalpy_JPerMol"]!);
        var (rF, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpyFlash(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 1000e3, h, 0.0, null, cp);
        double tS = Convert.ToDouble(rF["T_K"]!);
        Assert.InRange(tS, 148.0, 152.0);
        Assert.Equal("liquid", Convert.ToString(rF["phase"]));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Enthalpy_PhRequiresCp()
    {
        // без Cp_ig PH-слой недоступен — понятная ошибка валидации
        var ex = Assert.Throws<ValidationException>(() =>
            MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpyFlash(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 1000e3, -5000.0, 0.0, null,
                new Func<double, double>?[] { null, t => 60.0 }));
        Assert.Contains("Cp_ig", ex.Message);
    }
}

=== ФАЙЛ: tests/TecHet.Tests/R17Tests.cs
using System.Linq;
using TecHet.Api.DTOs;
using TecHet.Api.Services.Calc;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>R17 (v31): PT-flash, dew point, k_ij, двухфазная гидравлика (L-M), сепаратор (residence/demister), R18-метаданные.</summary>
public class R17Tests
{
    // данные эталонной смеси CH4/C2H6 (из PengRobinsonTests)
    private static readonly string[] Names = { "methane", "ethane" };
    private static readonly double[] Tc = { 190.564, 305.32 };
    private static readonly double[] Pc = { 4599.2e3, 4872.3e3 };
    private static readonly double[] Om = { 0.0115, 0.0995 };
    private static readonly double[] Mw = { 16.043, 30.07 };

    // ---------- PT-flash: инварианты ----------
    [Fact]
    public void Flash_TwoPhase_MassBalance()
    {
        var z = new[] { 0.5, 0.5 };
        double t = 200.0, p = 1000e3;   // ниже P_bub (~2110 кПа) — двухфазная область
        var (r, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveFlash(Names, Tc, Pc, Om, Mw, z, t, p, 0.0);
        double beta = (double)r["vapor_fraction"]!;
        Assert.True(beta > 0 && beta < 1, $"beta={beta}");
        var xArr = (System.Collections.IEnumerable)r["x_liquid"]!;
        var yArr = (System.Collections.IEnumerable)r["y_vapor"]!;
        double sx = 0, sy = 0;
        foreach (var o in xArr) sx += (double)o.GetType().GetProperty("x")!.GetValue(o)!;
        foreach (var o in yArr) sy += (double)o.GetType().GetProperty("y")!.GetValue(o)!;
        Assert.InRange(sx, 0.999, 1.001);
        Assert.InRange(sy, 0.999, 1.001);
        // массовый баланс: β·y + (1−β)·x = z (по каждому компоненту, допуск 1e-3 из-за округления до 4 знаков)
        double bx0 = beta * Y(yArr, 0) + (1 - beta) * X(xArr, 0);
        double bx1 = beta * Y(yArr, 1) + (1 - beta) * X(xArr, 1);
        Assert.InRange(bx0, 0.5 - 0.002, 0.5 + 0.002);
        Assert.InRange(bx1, 0.5 - 0.002, 0.5 + 0.002);
        Assert.Equal("two-phase", (string)r["phase"]!);
        Assert.True((bool)r["flash_converged"]!);
        // лёгкий компонент обогащает пар
        Assert.True(Y(yArr, 0) > X(xArr, 0));
    }

    [Fact]

    {

    }

        var (r, warns) = MixtureVleService.SolveFlash(Names, Tc, Pc, Om, Mw, z, t, pDew * 0.5, 0.0);

    }

    // ---------- dew point ----------
    [Fact]
    public void DewP_LowerThanBubble_AtSameT()
    {
        var z = new[] { 0.5, 0.5 };

        var rDew = MixtureVleService.Solve(Names, Tc, Pc, Om, Mw, z, t, kij: 0.0, mode: "dew");
        double pDew = Convert.ToDouble(rDew["dew_P_kPa"]);
        Assert.True(pDew < pBub - 1.0, $"dew={pDew} должен быть ниже bubble={pBub}");
        Assert.True(pDew > 0.15 * pBub, $"dew={pDew} — sanity против вырождения (для 50/50 CH4-C2H6 dew ≈ 0.2–0.6·bubble)");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void DewT_AboveBubbleT_AtSameP()
    {
        // стабильный случай: оба компонента ниже своей Tc (C2H6/C3H8 50/50, T=260 K)

        var rDewT = MixtureVleService.Solve(names2, tc2, pc2, om2, mw2, z2, 260.0, kij: 0.0, mode: "dew", pressurePa: pBub);

    }

    // ---------- двухфазная гидравлика (L-M) ----------
    [Fact]
    public void TwoPhase_Hydraulics_LM_Invariants()
    {
        var i = new HydraulicsInput(null, 300.0, 850.0, 1.2e-3, 100.0, 0.1, 10.0, 0.2, 2.0,
            QualityX: 0.3, VaporRhoKgM3: 12.0, VaporMuPaS: 1.1e-5);
        var r = HydraulicsCalc.Run(i).Result;
        double dPL = (double)r["dp_liquid_only_Pa"]!;
        double dPTp = (double)r["dP_total_Pa"]!;
        double phi = (double)r["phi_liquid_sq"]!;
        double X = (double)r["lockhart_X"]!;
        Assert.True(dPTp > dPL, $"dP_tp={dPTp} > dP_l={dPL}");
        Assert.True(phi > 1.0);
        Assert.Contains("двухфазный", (string)r["regime"]!);
        // формула: φ² = 1 + C/X + 1/X² — проверяем согласованность ключей
        double c = (double)r["lockhart_C"]!;
        Assert.InRange(phi, 1 + c / X, 1 + c / X + 1.0 / (X * X) + 1e-6);
        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)r["calc_version"]!));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Thermo_Etalon_Numbers()
    {
        // R17.1: числовые эталоны против thermo 0.6.1 (PRMIX/FlashVL), 14.11.2026:
        // dew-P 538.40, bubble 948.72 (C2/C3 260K), dew-T 278.32 K, flash beta 0.5471/0.3979 (CH4/C2H6 200K)
        var names2 = new[] { "ethane", "propane" };
        var tc2 = new[] { 305.32, 369.83 };
        var pc2 = new[] { 4872.3e3, 4248.0e3 };
        var om2 = new[] { 0.0995, 0.1523 };
        var mw2 = new[] { 30.07, 44.10 };
        var z2 = new[] { 0.5, 0.5 };
        double pDew = Convert.ToDouble(MixtureVleService.Solve(names2, tc2, pc2, om2, mw2, z2, 260.0, kij: 0.0, mode: "dew")["dew_P_kPa"]);
        Assert.InRange(pDew, 534.0, 543.0);   // thermo 538.40; расхождение к C# ≤0.03%
        double pBub = Convert.ToDouble(MixtureVleService.Solve(names2, tc2, pc2, om2, mw2, z2, 260.0)["bubble_P_kPa"]);
        Assert.InRange(pBub, 946.0, 958.0);   // thermo 948.72; расхождение ≤0.36%
        double pBubRef = pBub * 1000.0;
        var rDewT = MixtureVleService.Solve(names2, tc2, pc2, om2, mw2, z2, 260.0, kij: 0.0, mode: "dew", pressurePa: pBubRef);
        double tDew = Convert.ToDouble(rDewT["dew_T_K"]);
        Assert.InRange(tDew, 277.5, 279.5);   // thermo 278.32
        var (rF1, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveFlash(Names, Tc, Pc, Om, Mw, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 200.0, 1000e3, 0.0);
        Assert.InRange((double)rF1["vapor_fraction"]!, 0.542, 0.552);   // thermo 0.5471
        var (rF2, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveFlash(Names, Tc, Pc, Om, Mw, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 200.0, 1500e3, 0.0);
        Assert.InRange((double)rF2["vapor_fraction"]!, 0.393, 0.403);   // thermo 0.3979
    }

    private static double X(System.Collections.IEnumerable arr, int idx)
    {
        var list = arr.Cast<object>().ToList();
        return (double)list[idx].GetType().GetProperty("x")!.GetValue(list[idx])!;
    }

    private static double Y(System.Collections.IEnumerable arr, int idx)
    {
        var list = arr.Cast<object>().ToList();
        return (double)list[idx].GetType().GetProperty("y")!.GetValue(list[idx])!;
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>R18.2: интеграционный смоук sensitivity (OAT) через HTTP. Своя фикстура — свой хост,
/// лимит логина не конфликтует с R18SmoakTests.</summary>
public class R182SmoakTests : IClassFixture<TecHetAppFactory>
{
    private readonly TecHetAppFactory _f;
    public R182SmoakTests(TecHetAppFactory f) => _f = f;

    private (HttpClient, string Token) LoginAdmin()
    {
        var c = _f.CreateClient();
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/login", new { login = "budnikva2@yandex.ru", password = "1661" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);
        var json = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        return (c, json.GetProperty("token").GetString()!);
    }

    private JsonElement Post(HttpClient c, string url, object body)
    {
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync(url, body).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.True(resp.IsSuccessStatusCode,
            $"{url}: HTTP {(int)resp.StatusCode}: {resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult()}");
        return resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    }

    private int SubstanceId(HttpClient c, string q)
    {
        var resp = c.GetAsync($"/api/substances?q={Uri.EscapeDataString(q)}&size=50").GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);
        var json = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        foreach (var it in json.GetProperty("items").EnumerateArray())
            if (string.Equals(it.GetProperty("name").GetString(), q, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return it.GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
        return json.GetProperty("items")[0].GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Sensitivity_Hydraulics_Http()
    {
        var (c, token) = LoginAdmin();
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
        var json = Post(c, "/api/calc/sensitivity", new
        {
            type = "hydraulics",
            @params = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["rho"] = 750.0, ["mu"] = 5e-4, ["lengthM"] = 100.0, ["diameterM"] = 0.1, ["flowM3H"] = 10.0,
            },
            vary = new[] { new { param = "flowM3H" }, new { param = "diameterM" } },
            deltaPct = 25.0,
        });
        Assert.Equal("dP_total_bar", json.GetProperty("output_key").GetString());
        Assert.StartsWith("v", json.GetProperty("calc_version").GetString() ?? "");   // R18.3: версия растёт — проверяем формат
        var rows = json.GetProperty("rows");
        Assert.Equal(2, rows.GetArrayLength());
        // dP ∝ Q^1.85 / D^5: вклад диаметра сильнее вклада расхода — сортировка по max_abs_pct
        Assert.Equal("diameterM", rows[0].GetProperty("param").GetString());
        Assert.Equal("flowM3H", rows[1].GetProperty("param").GetString());
        // нелинейность вверх по расходу: +25% Q даёт больший прирост, чем −25% (по модулю)
        double qPlus = rows[1].GetProperty("delta_plus_pct").GetDouble();
        double qMinus = Math.Abs(rows[1].GetProperty("delta_minus_pct").GetDouble());
        Assert.True(qPlus > qMinus, $"+25% расхода должен влиять сильнее, чем −25%: {qPlus} vs {qMinus}");
        // рост диаметра снижает dP
        Assert.True(rows[0].GetProperty("delta_plus_pct").GetDouble() < 0, "+25% диаметра должен снижать dP");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Sensitivity_Vle_Pbub_GrowsWithT()
    {
        var (c, token) = LoginAdmin();
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
        int idCh4 = SubstanceId(c, "methane");
        int idC2 = SubstanceId(c, "ethane");
        var json = Post(c, "/api/calc/sensitivity", new
        {
            type = "mixture/vle",
            @params = new Dictionary<string, object>
            {
                ["components"] = new object[]
                {
                    new { substanceId = idCh4, molFrac = 0.5 },
                    new { substanceId = idC2, molFrac = 0.5 },
                },
                ["T"] = 200.0,
                ["mode"] = "bubble",
            },
            vary = new[] { new { param = "T" } },
            deltaPct = 10.0,
        });
        var rows = json.GetProperty("rows");
        Assert.Equal(1, rows.GetArrayLength());
        double dPlus = rows[0].GetProperty("delta_plus_pct").GetDouble();
        double dMinus = rows[0].GetProperty("delta_minus_pct").GetDouble();
        Assert.True(dPlus > 0, $"P_bub должен расти с T: {dPlus}");
        Assert.True(dMinus < 0, $"P_bub должен падать при T−10%: {dMinus}");
        Assert.True(rows[0].GetProperty("max_abs_pct").GetDouble() > 1.0, "чувствительность P_bub к T не нулевая");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Sensitivity_UnknownParam_Rejected()
    {
        var (c, token) = LoginAdmin();
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/calc/sensitivity", new
        {
            type = "hydraulics",
            @params = new Dictionary<string, object> { ["rho"] = 750.0 },
            vary = new[] { new { param = "unsupportedField" } },
            deltaPct = 10.0,
        }).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.True((int)resp.StatusCode is 400 or 422,
            $"неизвестный параметр должен давать честную ошибку, а не пустой график: {(int)resp.StatusCode}");
    }
}

        new("horizontal", 10, 2, 10, 0, 0, null, 0, 0, 1.0, null, null, null, null);

    }

using TecHet.Api.DTOs;
using TecHet.Api.Errors;
using TecHet.Api.Services.Calc;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>R18.3: регрессия сообщений при переносе валидаций в единый слой CalcInputValidator —
/// Calc.Run кидает ТЕ ЖЕ тексты в ТОМ ЖЕ порядке.</summary>
public class R183Tests
{
    private static string Msg(Action act)
    {
        try { act(); }
        catch (ValidationException ex) { return ex.Message; }
        return "<не выброшено>";
    }

    private static string RunHydraulics(HydraulicsInput i) => Msg(() => HydraulicsCalc.Run(i));
    private static string RunHeatTransfer(HeatTransferInput i) => Msg(() => HeatTransferCalc.Run(i));
    private static string RunSeparator(SeparatorInput i) => Msg(() => SeparatorCalc.Run(i));
    private static string RunSupportLoad(SupportLoadInput i) => Msg(() => SupportLoadCalc.Run(i));

    [Fact]
    public void Hydraulics_Messages_Unchanged()
    {
        Assert.Equal("Не задана плотность (rho).",
            RunHydraulics(new HydraulicsInput(null, null, null, 0.1, 100, 0.1, 10, null, null)));
        Assert.Equal("Диаметр должен быть > 0.",
            RunHydraulics(new HydraulicsInput(null, null, 750, 5e-4, 100, 0, 10, null, null)));
        Assert.Equal("Расход должен быть > 0.",
            RunHydraulics(new HydraulicsInput(null, null, 750, 5e-4, 100, 0.1, 0, null, null)));
        Assert.Equal("Длина не может быть отрицательной.",
            RunHydraulics(new HydraulicsInput(null, null, 750, 5e-4, -5, 0.1, 10, null, null)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Hydraulics_TwoPhase_Messages_Unchanged()
    {
        Assert.Equal("qualityX (массовая доля пара) должна быть в (0; 1).",
            RunHydraulics(new HydraulicsInput(null, null, 750, 5e-4, 100, 0.1, 10, null, null, 1.0, 5.0, 0.012)));
        Assert.Equal("Для двухфазного режима задайте vaporRhoKgM3 и vaporMuPaS (плотность и вязкость паровой фазы при условиях линии; оценка — вкладка «Пенг-Робинсон», mode=dew/flash).",
            RunHydraulics(new HydraulicsInput(null, null, 750, 5e-4, 100, 0.1, 10, null, null, 0.3, null, null)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Hydraulics_Order_FirstError()
    {
        // два нарушения сразу — сообщение первого по порядку (rho раньше diameter)
        Assert.Equal("Не задана плотность (rho).",
            RunHydraulics(new HydraulicsInput(null, null, null, null, 100, 0, 10, null, null)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void HeatTransfer_Messages_Unchanged()
    {
        Assert.Equal("Скорость потока должна быть > 0.",
            RunHeatTransfer(new HeatTransferInput(null, null, 750, 5e-4, 2100, 0.13, 0, 0.1, null, null, 2000, null)));
        Assert.Equal("Fouling не может быть отрицательным.",
            RunHeatTransfer(new HeatTransferInput(null, null, 750, 5e-4, 2100, 0.13, 1.5, 0.1, null, null, 2000, -1e-3)));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Separator_Messages_Unchanged()
    {
        Assert.Equal("K-фактор должен быть > 0.",
            RunSeparator(new SeparatorInput(750, 25, 10, 0)));
        Assert.Equal("Плотность жидкости должна быть больше плотности газа.",
            RunSeparator(new SeparatorInput(10, 25, null, null)));
        Assert.Equal("Расход газа должен быть > 0.",
            RunSeparator(new SeparatorInput(750, 25, 0, null)));
        Assert.Equal("K-фактор демистера должен быть > 0 (типично: mesh 0.107, vane 0.15, cyclone 0.30, без 0.04 м/с — GPSA; R19.2).",
            RunSeparator(new SeparatorInput(750, 25, 10, null, DemisterKFactor: 0)));   // регистр именованного — Pascal
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SupportLoad_Messages_Unchanged()
    {
        Assert.Equal("Габариты аппарата (длина/высота и диаметр) должны быть больше нуля.",
            RunSupportLoad(new SupportLoadInput("horizontal", 0, 2, 10, 0, 0, null, 0, 0, 1.0, null, null, null, null)));
        Assert.Equal("Заполнение — доля от 0 до 1.",
            RunSupportLoad(new SupportLoadInput("horizontal", 10, 2, 10, -0.5, 0, null, 0, 0, 1.0, null, null, null, null)));
        Assert.Equal("Пролёт между опорами не может превышать длину аппарата.",
            RunSupportLoad(new SupportLoadInput("horizontal", 10, 2, 10, 0, 0, null, 0, 0, 1.0, 12, null, null, null)));
        // валидная позиционная 14-аргументная форма — прежний результат
        var (result, _) = SupportLoadCalc.Run(new SupportLoadInput("horizontal", 10, 2, 10, 0, 0, null, 0, 0, 1.0, null, null, null, null));
        Assert.Equal("горизонтальный (2 опоры)", Convert.ToString(result["orientation"]));
    }

using TecHet.Api.DTOs;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>R18.4a: регрессия предупреждения liquid-PH после верификации департуры; плюс числовые
/// эталоны паровой/двухфазной департуры (пар — в допуске ~2%, сверка thermo 14.11.2026).</summary>
public class R184ATests

    {

        Assert.DoesNotContain(warns, w => w.Contains("R18.4b"));   // предупреждение — только для liquid
        double h = Convert.ToDouble(rH["enthalpy_JPerMol"]!);
        Assert.True(double.IsFinite(h) && Math.Abs(h) < 50000, $"пар-энтальпия конечна: {h}");
        // числовые эталоны паровой/двухфазной департуры — в R172Tests.Thermo_Etalon_Numbers (термо-сверка R17.1/R17.2)
    }
}

using TecHet.Api.DTOs;
using TecHet.Api.Services.Calc;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>R18.4b: после фикса знака ln-члена департуры — числовые thermo-эталоны (thermo 0.6.1
/// PRMIX, CH4/C2H6 50/50, сетка сверки 15.11.2026: liquid ±0.02%). dep = h − Σ zi·cp_i·(T−298.15).</summary>
public class R184BTests
{
    private static readonly double[] Tc2 = { 190.564, 305.32 };
    private static readonly double[] Pc2 = { 4599200, 4872000 };
    private static readonly double[] Om2 = { 0.011, 0.099 };
    private static readonly double[] Mw2 = { 16.0425, 30.069 };
    private static readonly string[] N2 = { "methane", "ethane" };

    private static Func<double, double>?[] CpConst2() => new Func<double, double>?[] { t => 40.0, t => 60.0 };

    [Fact]
    public void Dep_Liquid_ThermoEtalon_200K()
    {
        var cp = CpConst2();
        var (rH, warns) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpy(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 200.0, 3000e3, 0.0, null, cp);
        Assert.Equal("liquid", Convert.ToString(rH["phase"]));   // P=3 МПа > P_bub(200 K)≈2.11 МПа — субохлаждённая жидкость
        Assert.DoesNotContain(warns, w => w.Contains("департура") || w.Contains("R18.4b"));
        double h = Convert.ToDouble(rH["enthalpy_JPerMol"]!);
        double dep = h - (0.5 * 40.0 + 0.5 * 60.0) * (200.0 - 298.15);
        Assert.InRange(dep, -10098.0, -9898.0);   // thermo 0.6.1: −9997.4 (Z=0.0920)
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Dep_Liquid_ThermoEtalon_150K()
    {
        var cp = CpConst2();
        var (rH, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpy(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 150.0, 1000e3, 0.0, null, cp);
        double h = Convert.ToDouble(rH["enthalpy_JPerMol"]!);
        double dep = h - (0.5 * 40.0 + 0.5 * 60.0) * (150.0 - 298.15);
        Assert.InRange(dep, -11665.0, -11435.0);   // thermo 0.6.1: −11549.0 (раньше: +9138 — баг знака)
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Dep_Vapor_ThermoEtalon_300K()
    {
        var cp = CpConst2();
        var (rH, warns) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpy(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 300.0, 1000e3, 0.0, null, cp);
        Assert.Equal("vapor", Convert.ToString(rH["phase"]));
        Assert.DoesNotContain(warns, w => w.Contains("R18.4b"));
        double h = Convert.ToDouble(rH["enthalpy_JPerMol"]!);
        double dep = h - (0.5 * 40.0 + 0.5 * 60.0) * (300.0 - 298.15);
        Assert.InRange(dep, -372.0, -347.0);   // thermo 0.6.1: −359.62
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Ph_Inversion_Subcooled_SelfConsistent()
    {
        // инверсия enthalpy→ph: h при 160 K/1 МПа → T обратно ≈ 160 (самозамкнутость не нарушена фиксом)
        var cp = CpConst2();
        var (rH, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpy(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 160.0, 1000e3, 0.0, null, cp);
        double h = Convert.ToDouble(rH["enthalpy_JPerMol"]!);
        var (rF, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveEnthalpyFlash(N2, Tc2, Pc2, Om2, Mw2, new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 1000e3, h, 0.0, null, cp);
        Assert.Equal("liquid", Convert.ToString(rF["phase"]));
        double tS = Convert.ToDouble(rF["T_K"]!);
        Assert.InRange(tS, 158.0, 162.0);
    }
}

        var (r, _) = MixtureVleService.SolveFlash(N3, Tc3, Pc3, Om3, Mw3, new[] { 0.5, 0.3, 0.2 }, 230.0, 1.5e6, 0.0);
        double beta = Convert.ToDouble(r["vapor_fraction"]!);
        Assert.InRange(beta, 0.605, 0.620);   // thermo FlashVL: 0.6127
    }

    public void Correlation_RejectsUnsafeHeader()
    {
        var c = _f.CreateClient();
        var req = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, "/health");
        req.Headers.Add("X-Request-Id", "bad..value/../'--; drop table");
        var resp = c.SendAsync(req).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        var id = resp.Headers.GetValues("X-Request-Id").FirstOrDefault();
        Assert.NotEqual("bad..value/../'--; drop table", id);   // небезопасный — заменён сгенерированным
        Assert.False(string.IsNullOrEmpty(id));

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Headers;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>R18.1: интеграционный смоук R17/R17.2-эндпоинтов через HTTP-стек — замена ручного смоука
/// владельцем. Один логин на сценарий (лимит логина 10/мин — не исчерпываем). Проверки: ключи R17
/// сквозь сериализацию, эталоны thermo (dew 439.3 / bubble 2112), инверсия enthalpy→ph, kij-пары,
/// L-M-инвариант, сепаратор, сохранение с calc_version и PDF-эндпоинт.</summary>
public class R18SmoakTests : IClassFixture<TecHetAppFactory>
{
    private readonly TecHetAppFactory _f;
    public R18SmoakTests(TecHetAppFactory f) => _f = f;

    private (HttpClient, string Token) LoginAdmin()
    {
        var c = _f.CreateClient();
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/login", new { login = "budnikva2@yandex.ru", password = "1661" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);
        var json = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        return (c, json.GetProperty("token").GetString()!);
    }

    private int SubstanceId(HttpClient c, string token, string q)
    {
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new AuthenticationHeaderValue("Bearer", token);
        var resp = c.GetAsync($"/api/substances?q={Uri.EscapeDataString(q)}&size=50").GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);
        var json = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        var items = json.GetProperty("items");
        Assert.True(items.GetArrayLength() > 0, $"вещество «{q}» не найдено в сиде");
        // точное совпадение name (защита от «methanethiol» в выдаче «methane»)
        foreach (var it in items.EnumerateArray())
        {
            var name = it.GetProperty("name").GetString() ?? "";
            if (string.Equals(name, q, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return it.GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
        }
        return items[0].GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
    }

    private object Mix(int idCh4, int idC2) => new[]
    {
        new { substanceId = idCh4, molFrac = 0.5 },
        new { substanceId = idC2, molFrac = 0.5 },
    };

    private JsonElement PostCalc(HttpClient c, object body)
    {
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/calc/mixture/vle", body).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.True(resp.IsSuccessStatusCode,
            $"HTTP {(int)resp.StatusCode}: {resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult()}");
        return resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    }

    private JsonElement PostOk(HttpClient c, string url, object body)
    {
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync(url, body).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.True(resp.IsSuccessStatusCode,
            $"{url}: HTTP {(int)resp.StatusCode}: {resp.Content.ReadAsStringAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult()}");
        return resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
    }

    private static JsonElement ResultOf(JsonElement dto) => dto.GetProperty("result");

    [Fact]
    public void Vle_PhaseEndpooints_Smoak()
    {
        var (c, token) = LoginAdmin();
        int idCh4 = SubstanceId(c, token, "methane");
        int idC2 = SubstanceId(c, token, "ethane");

        // 1) flash: двухфазное состояние (thermo 0.6.1: VL, beta=0.5471)
        var j1 = PostCalc(c, new { components = Mix(idCh4, idC2), t = 200.0, mode = "flash", pressureKpa = 1000.0 });
        double beta = ResultOf(j1).GetProperty("vapor_fraction").GetDouble();
        Assert.InRange(beta, 0.50, 0.60);
        Assert.True(ResultOf(j1).TryGetProperty("calc_version", out _), "calc_version не проходит сквозь HTTP");
        Assert.True(j1.GetProperty("warnings").GetArrayLength() > 0, "warnings не доходят до клиента");
        Assert.Equal("two-phase", ResultOf(j1).GetProperty("phase").GetString());

        // 2) dew < bubble при том же T (эталоны thermo/R14)
        double dewP = ResultOf(PostCalc(c, new { components = Mix(idCh4, idC2), t = 200.0, mode = "dew" }))
            .GetProperty("dew_P_kPa").GetDouble();
        double bubP = ResultOf(PostCalc(c, new { components = Mix(idCh4, idC2), t = 200.0, mode = "bubble" }))
            .GetProperty("bubble_P_kPa").GetDouble();
        Assert.InRange(dewP, 430.0, 450.0);     // thermo: 439.33
        Assert.InRange(bubP, 2090.0, 2135.0);   // PR-эталон алгоритма (С2-а 16.11; физический — GERG R17.2-шаг 2)
        Assert.True(dewP < bubP, $"dew ({dewP}) должен быть ниже bubble ({bubP})");

        // 3) enthalpy → ph-инверсия
        double h = ResultOf(PostCalc(c, new { components = Mix(idCh4, idC2), t = 200.0, mode = "enthalpy", pressureKpa = 1000.0 }))
            .GetProperty("enthalpy_JPerMol").GetDouble();
        double tPh = ResultOf(PostCalc(c, new { components = Mix(idCh4, idC2), mode = "ph", pressureKpa = 1000.0, enthalpyJPerMol = h }))
            .GetProperty("T_K").GetDouble();
        Assert.InRange(tPh, 198.0, 202.0);

        // 4) k_ij-пара через HTTP поднимает P_bub
        double p0 = ResultOf(PostCalc(c, new { components = Mix(idCh4, idC2), t = 200.0, mode = "bubble" }))
            .GetProperty("bubble_P_kPa").GetDouble();
        double pK = ResultOf(PostCalc(c, new
        {
            components = Mix(idCh4, idC2), t = 200.0, mode = "bubble",
            kijPairs = new[] { new { i = 0, j = 1, value = 0.1 } }
        })).GetProperty("bubble_P_kPa").GetDouble();
        Assert.True(pK > p0, $"kij-пара должна поднять P_bub: {p0} → {pK}");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Hydraulics_TwoPhase_Invariant()
    {
        // свойства заданы напрямую (ρ/μ) — инвариант L-M не зависит от сид-точек вещества
        var (c, token) = LoginAdmin();

        double dP1 = PostOk(c, "/api/calc/hydraulics", new
        {
            rho = 750.0, mu = 5e-4, lengthM = 100.0, diameterM = 0.1, flowM3H = 10.0
        }).GetProperty("result").GetProperty("dP_total_Pa").GetDouble();

        double dP2 = PostOk(c, "/api/calc/hydraulics", new
        {
            rho = 750.0, mu = 5e-4, lengthM = 100.0, diameterM = 0.1, flowM3H = 10.0,
            qualityX = 0.3, vaporRhoKgM3 = 5.0, vaporMuPaS = 0.012
        }).GetProperty("result").GetProperty("dP_total_Pa").GetDouble();

        Assert.True(dP2 > dP1, $"двухфазная гидравлика (L-M) должна давать dP больше: {dP1} → {dP2}");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Separator_R17_Keys_ThroughHttp()
    {
        var (c, token) = LoginAdmin();
        var res = PostOk(c, "/api/calc/separator", new
        {
            rhoL = 750.0, rhoG = 25.0, flowM3H = 10.0,
            liquidFlowM3H = 1.0, residenceMin = 5.0, diameterM = 1.2, demisterKFactor = 0.1

        Assert.True(res.TryGetProperty("liquid_holdup_m3", out _), "нет liquid_holdup_m3");
        Assert.True(res.TryGetProperty("demister_required_area_m2", out _), "нет demister_required_area_m2");
        Assert.True(res.TryGetProperty("calc_version", out _), "calc_version отсутствует в сепараторе");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void SaveCalc_StoresCalcVersion_AndPdfHasMeta()
    {
        var (c, token) = LoginAdmin();
        int idCh4 = SubstanceId(c, token, "methane");
        int idC2 = SubstanceId(c, token, "ethane");
        var vle = PostCalc(c, new { components = Mix(idCh4, idC2), t = 200.0, mode = "flash", pressureKpa = 1000.0 });

        var proj = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/projects", new { name = "Смоук R18", unitName = "У-1" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult()
            .Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        int pid = proj.GetProperty("id").GetInt32();

        var rSave = c.PostAsJsonAsync($"/api/projects/{pid}/calcs", new
        {
            type = "mixture_pr",
            title = "Смоук PR-flash",
            input = new { t = 200.0, mode = "flash", pressureKpa = 1000.0 },
            result = ResultOf(vle),
            comment = "интеграционный смоук R18.1"
        }).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.Created, rSave.StatusCode);

        var list = c.GetAsync($"/api/projects/{pid}").GetAwaiter().GetResult()
            .Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        var calcs = list.GetProperty("calcs");
        Assert.True(calcs.GetArrayLength() > 0);
        var cvSmoke = calcs[0].GetProperty("calcVersion").GetString() ?? "";
        Assert.StartsWith("v", cvSmoke);   // R18.2: версия растёт — проверяем формат, не конкретное значение

        int calcId = calcs[0].GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
        var pdf = c.GetAsync($"/api/projects/{pid}/calcs/{calcId}/pdf").GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, pdf.StatusCode);
        Assert.Contains("application/pdf", pdf.Content.Headers.ContentType?.ToString() ?? "");

    [Fact]
    public void Vertical_ShellGeometry_ZonesSum()
    {
        var (c, token) = Login();
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new("Bearer", token);
        var json = Post(c, Sep(("orientation", "vertical"), ("diameterM", 1.2)));
        var res = json.GetProperty("result");
        Assert.Equal("vertical", res.GetProperty("orientation").GetString());
        double d = 1.2, area = Math.PI * d * d / 4.0;
        double hLiq = 50.0 / 60.0 * 5.0 / area;   // τ дефолт 5 мин
        double hTotal = hLiq + 0.75 * d + 0.15 * d;
        Assert.Equal(hTotal, res.GetProperty("shell_height_m").GetDouble(), 2);
        double ldAct = res.GetProperty("ld_ratio_actual").GetDouble();
        Assert.InRange(ldAct, 2.0, 6.0);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Horizontal_LengthByLdOrHoldup()
    {
        var (c, token) = Login();
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new("Bearer", token);
        var json = Post(c, Sep(("orientation", "horizontal"), ("ldRatio", 3.0), ("fillFrac", 0.5), ("diameterM", 1.2)));
        var res = json.GetProperty("result");
        double d = 1.2, area = Math.PI * d * d / 4.0;
        double vHold = 50.0 / 60.0 * 5.0;
        double lByHoldup = vHold / (0.5 * area);
        double lByLd = 3.0 * d;
        double shellL = Math.Max(lByHoldup, lByLd);
        Assert.Equal(shellL, res.GetProperty("shell_length_m").GetDouble(), 2);
        Assert.True(res.GetProperty("ld_ratio_actual").GetDouble() >= 3.0 - 1e-6);
    }

    [Fact]

        var json = Post(c, Sep(("demisterType", "mesh"), ("diameterM", 1.2)));
        var res = json.GetProperty("result");
        double dMin = res.GetProperty("min_captured_drop_micron").GetDouble();
        Assert.InRange(dMin, 40, 200);   // порядок величины, не хрупкий эталон
        var warns = json.GetProperty("warnings").EnumerateArray().Select(w => w.GetString() ?? "").ToList();

    }

/// <summary>R19.4: архитектура φ-φ — IActivityModel/IMixingRule, Wong–Sandler математика a_mix/b_mix.

    private const double Tc2 = 305.322, Pc2 = 4872200.0, Om2 = 0.0995;
    private const double TRef = 200.0;

    private static readonly double[] Tc = { Tc1, Tc2 };
    private static readonly double[] Pc = { Pc1, Pc2 };
    private static readonly double[] Om = { Om1, Om2 };

    private static (double[,] tau, double[,] alpha) Nrtl12()
    {
        var tau = new double[2, 2];
        var alpha = new double[2, 2];
        tau[0, 1] = 2.0; tau[1, 0] = 1.5;
        alpha[0, 1] = 0.3; alpha[1, 0] = 0.3;
        return (tau, alpha);
    }

    private static double[,] KijMatrix(double k)
    {
        var m = new double[2, 2];
        m[0, 1] = k; m[1, 0] = k;
        return m;
    }

    private static WongSandlerMixingRule Ws(double k = 0.01)
    {
        var (tau, alpha) = Nrtl12();
        var ge = new NrtlActivityModel(2, tau, alpha);
        return new WongSandlerMixingRule(Tc, Pc, Om, KijMatrix(k), KijMatrix(k), ge);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Ws_GammaContribution_MatchesReference()
    {
        var (tau, alpha) = Nrtl12();
        var ge = new NrtlActivityModel(2, tau, alpha);
        var x = new[] { 0.5, 0.5 };
        var g = ge.Gammas(x);
        double geRt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) geRt += x[i] * Math.Log(g[i]);
        Assert.Equal(0.6463642683122881, geRt, 10);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Ws_Diag_IdealGe_BmReference()
    {
        // python: при geRt=0 (идеальный γ), k=l=0.01: bm = S2/denom = 3.3173e-05
        var ws = new WongSandlerMixingRule(Tc, Pc, Om, KijMatrix(0.01), KijMatrix(0.01), IdealActivityModel.Instance);
        var (am, bm) = ws.Mix(new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, TRef);
        Assert.Equal(3.3356183202830006e-05, bm, 8);
        Assert.Equal(0.4535189243881516, am, 6);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Ws_MatchesPythonReference()
    {
        var (am, bm) = Ws().Mix(new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, TRef);
        // R19.5: Λ-форма (знак GE-члена исправлен): bm = 3.6657956164807004e-05, am = 0.4351896386686200
        Assert.Equal(3.6657956164807004e-05, bm, 10);
        Assert.Equal(0.4351896386686200, am, 10);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Ws_PureComponentLimit_Exact()
    {
        var (am, bm) = Ws().Mix(new[] { 1.0, 0.0 }, TRef);
        var (a, b, _) = MixtureVleService.PrParams(Tc, Pc, Om, TRef, 0.0, null);
        double relB = Math.Abs(bm - b[0]) / b[0];
        double relA = Math.Abs(am - a[0]) / a[0];
        Assert.True(relB < 1e-9, $"b_mix → b_i: rel {relB:0.0E0}");
        Assert.True(relA < 1e-9, $"a_mix → a_i: rel {relA:0.0E0}");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NrtlActivityModel_MatchesNrtlService()
    {
        var (tau, alpha) = Nrtl12();
        var via = new NrtlActivityModel(2, tau, alpha);
        var xs = new[] { new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, new[] { 0.9, 0.1 }, new[] { 0.1, 0.9 }, new[] { 0.3, 0.7 } };
        foreach (var x in xs)
        {
            var g1 = via.Gammas(x);
            var g2 = NrtlService.Gammas(2, x, tau, alpha);
            for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
                Assert.Equal(g2[i], g1[i], 12);
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void ClassicMixingRule_MatchesFormula()
    {
        var (a, b, aij) = MixtureVleService.PrParams(Tc, Pc, Om, TRef, 0.01, null);
        var rule = new ClassicMixingRule(aij, b);
        var x = new[] { 0.5, 0.5 };
        var (am, bm) = rule.Mix(x, TRef);
        double amRef = 0, bmRef = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        {
            bmRef += x[i] * b[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) amRef += x[i] * x[j] * aij[i, j];
        }
        Assert.Equal(amRef, am, 12);
        Assert.Equal(bmRef, bm, 12);
        Assert.Equal("classic", rule.Name);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Ws_InvariantsUnderStrongTau()
    {
        var (tau, alpha) = Nrtl12();
        tau[0, 1] = 6.0; tau[1, 0] = -3.5;   // сильная неидеальность
        var ge = new NrtlActivityModel(2, tau, alpha);
        var ws = new WongSandlerMixingRule(Tc, Pc, Om, KijMatrix(0.01), KijMatrix(0.01), ge);
        foreach (var x in new[] { new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, new[] { 0.2, 0.8 }, new[] { 0.8, 0.2 } })
        {
            var (am, bm) = ws.Mix(x, TRef);
            Assert.True(bm > 0 && double.IsFinite(bm));
            Assert.True(am > 0 && double.IsFinite(am));
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MixingRule_Validation()
    {
        var (c, token) = Login();
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new("Bearer", token);
        int m = SubstanceId(c, "methane"), e = SubstanceId(c, "ethane");
        var body = new
        {
            components = new[] { new { substanceId = m, molFrac = 0.5 }, new { substanceId = e, molFrac = 0.5 } },
            t = 200.0,
            mixingRule = "mhv2",
        };
        var r = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/calc/mixture/vle", body).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, r.StatusCode);
        var json = r.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Contains("classic", json.GetProperty("error").GetString());

        // R19.5: WS без activityModel → 400 (GE-модель обязательна)
        var bodyWsNoGe = new
        {
            components = new[] { new { substanceId = m, molFrac = 0.5 }, new { substanceId = e, molFrac = 0.5 } },
            t = 200.0,
            mixingRule = "wong-sandler",
        };
        var rWs = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/calc/mixture/vle", bodyWsNoGe).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.BadRequest, rWs.StatusCode);
        var jsonWs = rWs.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Contains("nrtl", jsonWs.GetProperty("error").GetString());
    }
}

/// <summary>R19.5: GE-перенос φ_i (Wong–Sandler, Λ-форма) + интеграция в контур bubble/dew/flash;

    private static string? _tokenCache;   // R19.6: один логин на класс — rate-limit 10 логинов/мин
    private static readonly object _tokenLock = new();
    private (HttpClient, string Token) Login()
    {
        var c = _f.CreateClient();
        lock (_tokenLock)
        {
            if (_tokenCache is null)
            {
                HttpStatusCode st = HttpStatusCode.BadRequest;
                for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 8; attempt++)
                {
                    var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/login", new { login = "budnikva2@yandex.ru", password = "1661" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
                    st = resp.StatusCode;
                    if (st == HttpStatusCode.OK)
                    {
                        _tokenCache = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult().GetProperty("token").GetString()!;
                        break;
                    }
                    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(2000);
                }
                Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, st);
            }
        }
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new("Bearer", _tokenCache!);
        return (c, _tokenCache!);
    }

    private static int SubstanceId(HttpClient c, string name)
    {
        var json = c.GetAsync($"/api/substances?q={Uri.EscapeDataString(name)}&size=50").GetAwaiter().GetResult()
            .Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        foreach (var it in json.GetProperty("items").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var nm = it.GetProperty("name").GetString() ?? "";
            if (string.Equals(nm, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return it.GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
        }
        return json.GetProperty("items").EnumerateArray().First().GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
    }

    // ---------- Юнит-эталоны производных (GE-перенос) ----------

    [Fact]
    public void MixingDerivs_Classic_Equivalence()
    {
        var (a, b, aij) = MixtureVleService.PrParams(Tc, Pc, Om, TRef, 0.01, null);
        var rule = new ClassicMixingRule(aij, b);
        var x = new[] { 0.5, 0.5 };
        var (am, bm) = rule.Mix(x, TRef);
        var (ad, bd) = MixingDerivs.Compute(rule, x, TRef);
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++)
        {
            double aSumI = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) aSumI += x[j] * aij[i, j];
            Assert.Equal(2 * aSumI - am, ad[i], 9);   // a_i^D = 2Σx_j a_ij − a_mix (классика)
            Assert.Equal(b[i], bd[i], 12);             // b_i^D = b_i (линейное правило)
        }
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MixingDerivs_Euler_Invariant_Ws()
    {
        var ws = Ws();
        var x = new[] { 0.5, 0.5 };
        var (am, bm) = ws.Mix(x, TRef);
        var (ad, bd) = MixingDerivs.Compute(ws, x, TRef);
        double sumAd = 0, sumBd = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) { sumAd += x[i] * ad[i]; sumBd += x[i] * bd[i]; }
        Assert.Equal(am, sumAd, 9);        // Σx·a_i^D = a_mix (Эйлер/однородность)
        Assert.Equal(bm, sumBd, 12);       // Σx·b_i^D = b_mix
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MixingDerivs_Ws_Reference()
    {
        var ws = Ws();
        var x = new[] { 0.5, 0.5 };
        var (ad, bd) = MixingDerivs.Compute(ws, x, TRef);
        // python-эталон (ε=1e-6): ad = [0.19540040380183754, 0.6749788734050632]
        //                          bd = [3.055590942961195e-05, 4.276000289865135e-05]
        Assert.Equal(0.19540040380183754, ad[0], 9);
        Assert.Equal(0.6749788734050632, ad[1], 9);
        Assert.Equal(3.055590942961195e-05, bd[0], 12);
        Assert.Equal(4.276000289865135e-05, bd[1], 12);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void MixingDerivs_PureDegeneracy_Exact()
    {
        var ws = Ws();
        var (a, b, _) = MixtureVleService.PrParams(Tc, Pc, Om, TRef, 0.01, null);
        var (ad1, bd1) = MixingDerivs.Compute(ws, new[] { 1.0, 0.0 }, TRef);
        Assert.Equal(a[0], ad1[0], 9);
        Assert.Equal(b[0], bd1[0], 12);
        var (ad2, bd2) = MixingDerivs.Compute(ws, new[] { 0.0, 1.0 }, TRef);
        Assert.Equal(a[1], ad2[1], 9);
        Assert.Equal(b[1], bd2[1], 12);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Ws_Bubble_Integration()
    {
        var (c, m, e) = Ready();
        var body = new
        {
            components = new[] { new { substanceId = m, molFrac = 0.5 }, new { substanceId = e, molFrac = 0.5 } },
            t = 200.0,
            kijPairs = new[] { new { i = 0, j = 1, value = 0.01 } },
            activityModel = "nrtl",
            nrtlPairs = new[] { new { i = 0, j = 1, tauIj = 2.0, tauJi = 1.5, alphaIj = 0.3 } },
            mixingRule = "wong-sandler",
            wsGeInVaporPhase = true,   // R19.6: R19.5-режим «GE в обеих фазах» — эталоны R19.5 сохранены
        };
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/calc/mixture/vle", body).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);
        var r = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        var result = r.GetProperty("result");
        double pb = result.GetProperty("bubble_P_kPa").GetDouble();
        // R31b: переснято после WS/SumK-фиксов: 2381.61 был псевдокорнем (R22.1, verified=false) —
        // новый SumK находит ИСТИННЫЙ корень 3625.35 кПа (арбитр 25.11.2026, verified=true).
        // R31c: разброс арбитров по P ~1% (3625.35 vs 3661.97, y совпадают точно) — допуск ±1.5%,
        // после прогона центрировать на факте.
        Assert.InRange(pb, 3625.35 * 0.985, 3625.35 * 1.015);
        // y при bubble-WS (арбитр R31b): метан 0.8612, этан 0.1388 (±0.02)
        var yArr = result.GetProperty("y_vapor");
        double yM = 0, yE = 0;
        foreach (var it in yArr.EnumerateArray())
        {
            if (string.Equals(it.GetProperty("name").GetString(), "methane")) yM = it.GetProperty("y").GetDouble();
            if (string.Equals(it.GetProperty("name").GetString(), "ethane")) yE = it.GetProperty("y").GetDouble();
        }
        Assert.InRange(yM, 0.8612 - 0.02, 0.8612 + 0.02);
        Assert.InRange(yE, 0.1388 - 0.02, 0.1388 + 0.02);
        Assert.Contains("Wong–Sandler", result.GetProperty("method").GetString());
        Assert.Equal("v36.14", result.GetProperty("calc_version").GetString());
        bool wsAssumption = false;
        foreach (var it in result.GetProperty("assumptions").EnumerateArray())
            if (it.GetString()!.Contains("Wong–Sandler")) wsAssumption = true;
        Assert.True(wsAssumption, "assumptions: нет R19.5-строки φ-φ WS");
        bool wsWarn = false;
        foreach (var it in r.GetProperty("warnings").EnumerateArray())
            if (it.GetString()!.Contains("Wong–Sandler")) wsWarn = true;
        Assert.True(wsWarn, "warnings: нет R19.5-строки φ-φ WS");
    }

            mode = "flash",
            pressureKpa = 1800.0,
            kijPairs = new[] { new { i = 0, j = 1, value = 0.01 } },
            activityModel = "nrtl",
            nrtlPairs = new[] { new { i = 0, j = 1, tauIj = 2.0, tauJi = 1.5, alphaIj = 0.3 } },
            mixingRule = "wong-sandler",
            wsGeInVaporPhase = true,
        };
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/calc/mixture/vle", body).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);
        var r = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        var result = r.GetProperty("result");
        Assert.True(result.GetProperty("flash_converged").GetBoolean(), "R19.6: Мичельсен должен сходиться на R19.5-кейсе неустойчивости");
        Assert.InRange(result.GetProperty("vapor_fraction").GetDouble(), 0.45, 0.70);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Ws_Ph_ClassicEnthalpyWarned()
    {
        // R19.6 (решение владельца А4): PH при WS — классическая энтальпия PR с честным
        // предупреждением (GE-вклад не учтён: τ без T-зависимости — H^E вырождается).
        var (c, m, e) = Ready();
        var body = new
        {
            components = new[] { new { substanceId = m, molFrac = 0.5 }, new { substanceId = e, molFrac = 0.5 } },
            t = 200.0,
            mode = "ph",
            pressureKpa = 2000.0,
            enthalpyJPerMol = -800.0,   // T_flash ≈ 297 K < Tc(C2H6)=305.3 — не сверхкритично (R19.6)
            kijPairs = new[] { new { i = 0, j = 1, value = 0.01 } },
            activityModel = "nrtl",
            nrtlPairs = new[] { new { i = 0, j = 1, tauIj = 2.0, tauJi = 1.5, alphaIj = 0.3 } },
            mixingRule = "wong-sandler"
        };
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/calc/mixture/vle", body).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        if (resp.StatusCode != HttpStatusCode.OK)
        {
            var err = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
            Assert.True(false, "PH-WS диагностика: " + err.GetProperty("error").GetString());
        }
        var r = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.True(r.TryGetProperty("warnings", out var wEl), "PH-WS диагностика body: " + r.GetRawText().Substring(0, Math.Min(300, r.GetRawText().Length)));
        bool warned = false;
        foreach (var it in wEl.EnumerateArray())
            if (it.GetString()!.Contains("GE-вклад в энтальпию не учтён")) warned = true;
        Assert.True(warned, "warnings: нет R19.6-предупреждения о классической энтальпии при WS");
        var result = r.GetProperty("result");
        double h = result.GetProperty("h_target_JPerMol").GetDouble();   // PH-flash (mode=ph): целевая энтальпия
        Assert.True(Math.Abs(h) < 1e9, "энтальпия конечна");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Ws_Classic_Regression()
    {
        // mixingRule="classic" без GE-модели — прежний путь (mixingContext null):
        // R31b: переснято после SumK-фикса — при kij=0 истинный корень 2640.74 кПа (арбитр 25.11.2026);
        // прежний 2111.45 — псевдокорень.
        var (c, m, e) = Ready();
        var body = new
        {
            components = new[] { new { substanceId = m, molFrac = 0.5 }, new { substanceId = e, molFrac = 0.5 } },
            t = 200.0,
            kij = 0.0,
            mixingRule = "classic",
        };
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/calc/mixture/vle", body).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);
        var r = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        double pb = r.GetProperty("result").GetProperty("bubble_P_kPa").GetDouble();
        Assert.InRange(pb, 2640.74 * 0.995, 2640.74 * 1.005);   // R31b: переснято (kij=0)
        bool wsWarn = false;
        foreach (var it in r.GetProperty("warnings").EnumerateArray())
            if (it.GetString()!.Contains("Wong–Sandler")) wsWarn = true;
        Assert.False(wsWarn, "warnings: «Wong–Sandler» при mixingRule=classic не должен появляться");
        Assert.Equal("v36.14", r.GetProperty("result").GetProperty("calc_version").GetString());
    }
}

using System.Net;
using System.Net.Http.Json;
using System.Text.Json;
using TecHet.Api.Services.Calc;
using Xunit;

namespace TecHet.Tests;

/// <summary>
/// R19.6: Мичельсен (stability-тест TPD multi-start + демпфированный SS) для flash при WS;
/// GE только в жидкой фазе (решение владельца А2) + флаг сравнения WsGeInVaporPhase;
/// PH при WS — классическая энтальпия (А4); предупреждения А3/А5/А7; LL-детекция (Г15).
/// Эталоны — независимая python-реализация (CHANGELOG R19.6); допуски с учётом известного
/// разброса SS при GE-моделях (R19.5: ±4%; немонотонность P_bub при GE — CHANGELOG R19.6).
/// </summary>
public class R196Tests : IClassFixture<TecHetAppFactory>
{
    private readonly TecHetAppFactory _f;
    public R196Tests(TecHetAppFactory f) => _f = f;

    private static string? _tokenCache;   // R19.6: один логин на класс — rate-limit 10 логинов/мин
    private static readonly object _tokenLock = new();
    private (HttpClient, string Token) Login()
    {
        var c = _f.CreateClient();
        lock (_tokenLock)
        {
            if (_tokenCache is null)
            {
                HttpStatusCode st = HttpStatusCode.BadRequest;
                for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 8; attempt++)
                {
                    var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/auth/login", new { login = "budnikva2@yandex.ru", password = "1661" }).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
                    st = resp.StatusCode;
                    if (st == HttpStatusCode.OK)
                    {
                        _tokenCache = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult().GetProperty("token").GetString()!;
                        break;
                    }
                    System.Threading.Thread.Sleep(2000);
                }
                Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, st);
            }
        }
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new("Bearer", _tokenCache!);
        return (c, _tokenCache!);
    }

    private static int SubstanceId(HttpClient c, string name)
    {
        var json = c.GetAsync($"/api/substances?q={Uri.EscapeDataString(name)}&size=50").GetAwaiter().GetResult()
            .Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        foreach (var it in json.GetProperty("items").EnumerateArray())
        {
            var nm = it.GetProperty("name").GetString() ?? "";
            if (string.Equals(nm, name, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
                return it.GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
        }
        return json.GetProperty("items").EnumerateArray().First().GetProperty("id").GetInt32();
    }

    internal (HttpClient c, int w, int et) ReadyShared() => ReadyWe();

    private (HttpClient c, int w, int et) ReadyWe()
    {
        var (c, token) = Login();
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new("Bearer", token);
        int w = SubstanceId(c, "water"), et = SubstanceId(c, "ethanol");
        return (c, w, et);
    }

    private (HttpClient c, int m, int e) Ready()
    {
        var (c, token) = Login();
        c.DefaultRequestHeaders.Authorization = new("Bearer", token);
        int m = SubstanceId(c, "methane"), e = SubstanceId(c, "ethane");
        return (c, m, e);
    }

    private static (JsonElement result, JsonElement root) Post(HttpClient c, object body)
    {
        var resp = c.PostAsJsonAsync("/api/calc/mixture/vle", body).GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        Assert.Equal(HttpStatusCode.OK, resp.StatusCode);
        var r = resp.Content.ReadFromJsonAsync<JsonElement>().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
        return (r.GetProperty("result"), r);
    }

    private static bool HasWarn(JsonElement root, string needle)
    {
        foreach (var it in root.GetProperty("warnings").EnumerateArray())
            if (it.GetString()!.Contains(needle)) return true;
        return false;
    }

    private static double[,] KM()
    {
        var m = new double[2, 2];
        m[0, 1] = 0.01; m[1, 0] = 0.01;
        return m;
    }

    // ---------- Юнит: фазовое переключение GE (А2) ----------

    [Fact]
    public void Debug_SetVaporPhase_WsMix()
    {
        // Mix при активной паровой фазе — GE не входит (useGe=false); при жидкой — входит.
        // Эталоны python (после исправления диагонали B_ii, урок R19.4 повторён):
        // vapor-no-GE: am=0.45351892438815, bm=3.335618320283e-05;
        // liquid-GE:   am=0.43518963866862, bm=3.6657956164807e-05 (=R19.5-эталон am).
        var ws = new WongSandlerMixingRule(new[] { 190.564, 305.322 }, new[] { 4599200.0, 4872200.0 },
            new[] { 0.0114, 0.0995 }, KM(), KM(),
            new NrtlActivityModel(2, new double[2, 2] { { 0.0, 2.0 }, { 1.5, 0.0 } }, new double[2, 2] { { 0.0, 0.3 }, { 0.3, 0.0 } }));
        using (MixingContext.Use(ws, false))
        {
            MixingContext.SetVaporPhase(true);
            var (am, bm) = ws.Mix(new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 200.0);
            Assert.InRange(am, 0.45351892438815 * 0.99, 0.45351892438815 * 1.01);
            Assert.InRange(bm, 3.335618320283e-05 * 0.99, 3.335618320283e-05 * 1.01);
            MixingContext.SetVaporPhase(false);
            var (am2, bm2) = ws.Mix(new[] { 0.5, 0.5 }, 200.0);
            Assert.InRange(am2, 0.43518963866862 * 0.99, 0.43518963866862 * 1.01);
            Assert.InRange(bm2, 3.6657956164807e-05 * 0.99, 3.6657956164807e-05 * 1.01);
        }
    }
